summary: Centrus Energy Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a material definitive agreement. On April 16, 2026, its wholly owned subsidiary American Centrifuge Operating, LLC entered a construction contract with Geiger Brothers, Inc. for expansion of its uranium enrichment facility in Piketon, Ohio, with a performance period through January 2031 and an aggregate cap of $900 million. The contract uses a time and materials pricing structure. This is a routine operational agreement, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
